title: The Embodied Voice
short_description: The Embodied Voice is a practice for living more joyfully in mind and body by bringing together voice, movement, mindful awareness and improvisation. Balancing science and technique with play and creativity, it helps us tap into a voice and body that is free, expressive, vital and present.
description:
## SINGING INTO PRESENCE
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
MAY 3–9, 2026  
VOICE RETREAT

Join The Embodied Voice for 6 days of moving, sounding and singing, to
- Nourish your body, mind and voice
- Cultivate clarity and presence
- Unlock your creativity
- Awaken your vitality
- Restore, rest, reflect
- Release into flow

### The Facilitators
Kate — vocal acrobat, composer and facilitator  
Creator of The Embodied Voice©, a research, performance and teaching practice addressing presence, body-mind relationship and human rewilding through voice, movement and improvisation

Liv — working with the voice as a tool for healing for 15 years across many settings  
Inspired by Hindustani singing studies and years in India  
Weaves jazz singing, creative practice, singing therapy and yoga teaching into Voice Yoga

[More Information](https://theembodiedvoice.net/offerings/singingintopresence2026)
